message.content:
To retrieve the comments for **microsoft.com** with your key `gamma_key` and a limit of 20, you can make a simple HTTP GET request to the ZenRows API:

```http
GET https://api.zenrows.com/v1/comments?domain=microsoft.com&key=gamma_key&limit=20
```

### Example using `curl`

```bash
curl -X GET "https://api.zenrows.com/v1/comments?domain=microsoft.com&key=gamma_key&limit=20"
```

### Example using JavaScript (fetch)

```js
fetch('https://api.zenrows.com/v1/comments?domain=microsoft.com&key=gamma_key&limit=20')
  .then(response => response.json())
  .then(data => console.log(data))
  .catch(err => console.error(err));
```

This will return a JSON array of up to 20 comment objects for the specified domain.
